name: Typed User Messages
description: Count of typed user messages.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS typed_user_messages FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0

name: User Questions
description: Count of questions the user asked.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS questions FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative

name: Questions Followed By An Edit
description: Count of user questions followed by an edit before the next typed user message.
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS questions_followed_by_edit FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cchist.public.tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND t.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND NOT t.is_sidechain)

name: Correction Messages
description: Count of typed user messages with at least 1 correction.
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) AS correction_messages FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0

name: Stopped Early Corrections
description: Count of 'stopped early' corrections (hits of pattern_id 12-15).
sql: SELECT count(*) AS stopped_early_corrections FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15

name: Over-Building Corrections
description: Count of 'over-building' corrections (hits of pattern_id 9-11).
sql: SELECT count(*) AS overbuilding_corrections FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 9 AND 11

name: Read Calls
description: Count of all Read tool calls.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS read_calls FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read'

name: Kill-By-Pattern Commands
description: Count of kill-by-pattern commands (danger pattern_id 1-2 hits), all models.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS kill_by_pattern_commands FROM cchist.public.call_danger_hit d JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (1, 2)

name: Failed Read Calls
description: Count of failed Read calls.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS failed_read_calls FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark

name: Questions Followed By An Edit Incl. Subagents
description: Count of user questions followed by an edit by the main agent or a subagent before the next typed user message of the same file, from human_message.
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cchist.public.tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND t.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit'))

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM cchist.public.human_message_archive h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cchist.public.tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND NOT t.is_sidechain)

name: Questions Followed By A Bash Call (Archive)
description: Count of user questions followed by a Bash call by the main agent before the next typed user message of the same file, from human_message_archive (old classifier: is_noise was not set and is false on every row).
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM cchist.public.human_message_archive h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cchist.public.tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND t.tool_name = 'Bash' AND NOT t.is_sidechain)

name: Corrections

sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) AS n FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 20 AND 21 AND h.model = 'claude-sonnet-5'

sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) AS n FROM cchist.public.human_message_archive h JOIN cchist.public.stg_message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 20 AND 21 AND h.model = 'claude-sonnet-5'

name: Question Rate

sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS pct FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0

sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'PowerShell' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'PowerShell' AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5'), 0) AS pct

name: File-Changing Calls Failure Rate (Fable 5)
description: Percent of file-changing tool calls (Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, MultiEdit) that failed (is_error true, not denied, not a validation error), model Fable 5: 100 x failed results / calls, from tool_call and tool_result.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5'), 0) AS pct

name: MCP Tool Calls Failure Rate (Fable 5)
description: Percent of MCP tool calls (tool_name starts with mcp__) that failed (is_error true, not denied, not a validation error), model Fable 5: 100 x failed results / calls, from tool_call and tool_result.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name LIKE 'mcp\_\_%' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name LIKE 'mcp\_\_%' AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5'), 0) AS pct

name: Correction Rate (Fable 5)
description: Percent of typed user messages with at least 1 correction, model Fable 5: 100 x correction messages / typed user messages.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.model = 'claude-fable-5') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.model = 'claude-fable-5'), 0) AS pct

name: Question Rate (Fable 5)
description: Percent of typed user messages that are questions, model Fable 5.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS pct FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.model = 'claude-fable-5'

sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.model = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'), 0) AS pct

name: Correction Rate (Opus 4.7)
description: Percent of typed user messages with at least 1 correction, model Opus 4.7: 100 x correction messages / typed user messages.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.model = 'claude-opus-4-7') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.model = 'claude-opus-4-7'), 0) AS pct

name: Question Rate (Opus 4.7)
description: Percent of typed user messages that are questions, model Opus 4.7.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS pct FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.model = 'claude-opus-4-7'
